plan.summary: Deploy a secure internal enterprise administration portal on Google Cloud Run v2 secured with Cloud Run Direct IAP (no OAuth client/secret), FastAPI backend with ES256 JWT IAP assertion verification, embedded Tailwind CSS UI, RBAC (Viewer and SuperAdmin), immutable Firestore audit logging in admin_audit_events, and a $10.00 FinOps monthly budget cap.
plan.architecture_overview: A single-service serverless architecture hosted on Google Cloud Run v2 (min_instances = 0, 512 MiB memory) in a healthy region (us-central1) with Direct IAP enabled natively on the Cloud Run service without custom OAuth clients or secrets. Perimeter authentication is enforced by IAP/IAM, disallowing unauthenticated public access. Inside the FastAPI application, custom authentication middleware cryptographically verifies the X-Goog-IAP-JWT-Assertion header using IAP ES256 public keys against the exact Cloud Run service audience (/projects/<project-number>/locations/<region>/services/ex09-live), strictly ignoring unsigned headers like X-Goog-Authenticated-User-Email. Verified claims drive RBAC authorization (Viewer vs. SuperAdmin) for administrative operations (user role updates and feature flag toggles) served via REST APIs and an embedded Tailwind CSS dashboard. Every mutating administrative action writes an immutable audit record to Google Cloud Firestore Native (admin_audit_events collection). No Compute Engine VMs or VPC connectors are used, natively satisfying folder organization policies while maintaining a projected monthly cost well within the $10.00 FinOps budget cap enforced via Cloud Billing Budgets.

code_tasks.title: Implement FastAPI IAP JWT Verification Middleware, RBAC, Audit Logging, and Tailwind UI
code_tasks.description: Implement the FastAPI internal administration portal under apps/ex09-live/. Build authentication middleware that extracts X-Goog-IAP-JWT-Assertion, verifies its ES256 signature against IAP's public keys, validates issuer (https://cloud.google.com/iap) and exact Cloud Run service audience (/projects/<project-number>/locations/<region>/services/<service-name>), and derives operator email and sub strictly from the verified JWT claims while completely ignoring unsigned headers such as X-Goog-Authenticated-User-Email. Implement RBAC distinguishing Viewer (read-only access to portal state, users, feature flags, and audit logs) and SuperAdmin (authorized to update user roles and toggle feature flags). Persist every administrative mutation (user role updates, feature flag toggles) as an immutable event document in Firestore collection admin_audit_events (with timestamp, actor email/sub, action type, target resource, previous/new state, and request metadata), disallowing update or delete operations on audit documents. Serve an embedded Tailwind CSS administrative UI at GET / and provide a health check endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Middleware verifies ES256 signature and /projects/<project-number>/locations/<region>/services/<service-name> audience on X-Goog-IAP-JWT-Assertion
Unsigned X-Goog-Authenticated-User-Email header is never trusted or used for identity
RBAC enforces Viewer read-only permissions (403 on mutations) and SuperAdmin write permissions
All user role updates and feature flag toggles append immutable audit entries to Firestore collection admin_audit_events
Embedded Tailwind CSS administrative portal UI renders operator identity, role, users, feature flags, and audit trail

code_tasks.title: Implement 100% Coverage Pytest Suite with Real ES256 IAP JWT Signing
code_tasks.description: Develop comprehensive pytest test suite achieving 100% test coverage across application modules. Generate an ephemeral ES256 key pair during tests, inject the public JWK/public key into the IAP key resolver, and sign real JWT assertions for X-Goog-IAP-JWT-Assertion so full cryptographic verification runs in tests. Cover valid Viewer and SuperAdmin assertions, missing assertions, expired tokens, wrong audience (including OAuth client ID audience rejection), tampered signatures, spoofing attempts via X-Goog-Authenticated-User-Email without valid JWT, RBAC enforcement on user role updates and feature flag toggles, immutable Firestore admin_audit_events emission, and Tailwind UI rendering. Document architecture, Direct IAP setup, RBAC model, and FinOps controls in README.md.
acceptance_criteria: 100% passing pytest coverage across application modules
Tests dynamically generate an ES256 key pair and execute real cryptographic JWT verification
Tests verify rejection of OAuth-client-style audiences, forged signatures, and unsigned X-Goog-Authenticated-User-Email headers
Tests verify Viewer vs SuperAdmin RBAC and immutable admin_audit_events Firestore writes
